title: ESC-mid-drag: pending release re-selects the node (swallow latch not honored on the drag-release click-select path)
detail: ESC deselect sets press_swallowed but never clears drag.active; the drag-branch release click-selects without the swallow gate, so press-node → ESC → release re-selects the node, contradicting this code's own comment and the PR's interaction map.
recommended_fix: Gate the drag-branch click-select on !app.press_swallowed (matching the plain-release branch), or clear app.drag.active in the ESC deselect branch.
